scope: This proves the additive cubic-CM coordinate action and the explicit norm-torsion implication. It does not construct a collision-derived linear relation, prove torsion-to-division-polynomial vanishing, construct or prove vanishing of the specialized Semaev polynomial, or establish a subexponential ECDLP runtime theorem.
statement: On an elliptic short curve Y squared equals X cubed plus B over a field of characteristic not two, a nonidentity cubic root of unity defines an additive affine-point endomorphism zeta satisfying zeta squared plus zeta plus one equals zero; any relation a P plus b zeta(P) equals zero therefore makes the explicit Eisenstein norm a squared minus a b plus b squared annihilate P.
